community_list_entries.name: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A bounded-memory testbed in Slay the Spire 2 with five ablatable memory layers, including L4 episodic postrun summaries and an L5 skill library learned from earlier runs. It releases 298 trajectories, frozen memory/skill snapshots and analysis scripts. Win-rate ablations are small (10 games per cell

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Sec 4.2: "L5 skill library stores triggered strategic guides distilled from logs"; Sec 6.3: "Runs with postrun-active memory attempt A6–A8, while no-postrun streams stop at A2–A4"
